{{Quote|Binkss brokeen the nocombackie law. Hisen to be pounded until death!|[[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], after [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] broke the nocombackie law|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
The '''Nocombackie Law''' (also called the '''Not-Coming-Back Law''' or '''Gungan Law of Banishment''') was a ruling handed down by the [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Gungan High Council]]. It banished the accused from ever returning to a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|city]], on pain of [[Death/Legends|death]]. [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] placed [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] under the Nocombackie law after a destructive accident involving Nass's personal [[Heyblibber/Legends|heyblibber]].<ref name="Ep 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>
